input_schema.title: JobStreet Jobs Scraper
input_schema.description: Fast, stealthy API-based scraper for JobStreet job listings across MY, SG, PH, and ID.

startUrl.title: Start URL
startUrl.description: A JobStreet search URL. If provided, this will be used instead of Keyword/Location. E.g., https://my.jobstreet.com/developer-jobs/in-Malaysia

location.title: Location (optional)
location.description: Optional typed location filter, e.g., 'Singapore', 'Kuala Lumpur', or 'Manila'. Leave blank to search the selected country site without forcing a location.

country.title: Country Site
country.description: The JobStreet country domain to use for keyword/location searches.

posted_date.title: Posted Date Filter
posted_date.description: Filter jobs by how recently they were posted (only works with keyword/location search).

results_wanted.title: Results Wanted
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of jobs to collect.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional Apify proxy configuration. Keep disabled for direct API requests, or enable it when the JobStreet API rate-limits or blocks the execution environment.

events.title: result
events.description: Single result in the default dataset.

events.title: Actor Start
events.description: Charged when the Actor starts running. Number of events charged depends on Actor memory (one event per GB, minimum one event).

readme:
## JobStreet Jobs Scraper

JobStreet Jobs Scraper is a JobStreet scraper for collecting structured job listings from Malaysia, Singapore, the Philippines, and Indonesia. It accepts a keyword/location search or a JobStreet search results URL and returns structured records including job titles and descriptions, hiring company names and branding/logo links, salary ranges or labels, published locations, employment types, industry classifications and sub-classifications, work-arrangement labels (remote/hybrid/on-site), posting dates (ISO and human-readable), unique listing identifiers and direct job URLs, listing status flags (featured/premium/expired) and collection timestamps. The Actor gathers listing summaries plus full descriptions in plain text and HTML and uses JobStreet’s public search API and GraphQL detail endpoint to retrieve listing metadata and detail content for recruitment research, market analysis, and automated monitoring of Southeast Asian job markets.

## Use cases

- Recruitment research and candidate sourcing across Malaysia, Singapore, the Philippines, and Indonesia  
- Hiring intelligence and employer comparison (companies, posting cadence, featured/premium listings)  
- Salary benchmarking using published salary ranges or labels  
- Job board data collection and aggregation for market coverage analysis  
- Skills analysis and classification extraction from job descriptions  
- Recurring monitoring and trend reporting of regional employment markets (job alerts, hiring trends)
